subject.title: [Bug]: tools.elevated.enabled: true breaks exec routing logic (tools.

question: Should OpenClaw keep enabled elevated sessions as host-exec by default, or change the contract so sandbox exec remains the default unless elevation is explicitly requested?
rationale: The source-reproducible behavior crosses the sandbox boundary, but current docs intentionally define /elevated ask as on and changing the default can affect existing trusted-operator workflows.

options.title: Default implicit elevation off
options.body: Change the no-explicit-level fallback to off, preserve explicit /elevated on|ask|full behavior, and update docs/tests for the safer default.

options.title: Redefine ask as opt-in
options.body: Make /elevated ask keep sandbox exec by default and route only explicit elevated exec calls to host with approvals, accepting a larger contract change.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Treat tools.elevated.enabled as opt-in to session-level host exec by default and close only after docs make that security posture unmistakable.

recommendation.title: Default implicit elevation off
recommendation.body: Change the no-explicit-level fallback to off, preserve explicit /elevated on|ask|full behavior, and update docs/tests for the safer default.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-history connection to the affected elevated default and exec routing paths.
